listings.quoteOnly: Dine-in all-you-can-eat sets, arranged directly with the restaurant. The linked standard menu lists regular and member prices; confirm current branch pricing and lunch promotions before visiting.
listings.menuNote: The standard menu currently linked from both official location pages. Member prices require paid annual membership; promotional lunch pricing is separate.

panels.head: What each set includes
body: Silver lists a choice of one specialty dish per person, Australian Wagyu chuck ribeye, brisket and shoulder, limited seafood platter, Jidori chicken and Kurobuta pork. Specialty choices include Wagyu bone marrow, tartare, nigiri and sweet shrimp sashimi.
Gold includes Silver items and lists Japanese A5 chuck ribeye and shoulder at one portion each per person, A5 brisket, full-blood M9+ Australian chuck ribeye and shoulder, and seasonal pearl grouper.
Diamond includes the preceding sets and lists unlimited specialty dishes, Japanese A5 chuck ribeye, brisket and shoulder, plus a seafood platter. Items depend on supply.

panels.head: Dining time and member prices
body: The published menu has a 90-minute dining limit and requires the whole party to choose the same set price. It lists a $6 charge per wasted plate and, during peak hours, a 20% surcharge for each additional 30 minutes.
The linked policy lists annual membership at $28 per person. Its member prices are separate from the regular menu; membership is arranged directly with the restaurant.
The published child policy is height-based: 110cm and under free, 111–140cm half price, 141cm and above full price. Confirm current terms and any dated lunch offer directly.

sourceNotes: 127 sends and 44 image attachments after Batch111. Two non-catalog messages are recorded with their private conversation text omitted; no outreach or financial action was taken.
40 distinct source films; DQ-CZNRERx0 was sent twice. Both requests remain on one deduplicated film.
One House Bakery icon artwork enlarged within its original square without moving its seat; Backyard is the Richmond business, not Backyard Bayou.

Existing Hot Pot category retained and appended; Greek is the one new category. Both Shabu Club branches have city pages. Mikiya San Mateo is a separate page because the owner Linktree lists it and two submitted films name that branch.

Ones Alameda has its own current 90-row Toast menu and phone; the Castro Valley page retains its earlier menu/address and gets the explicitly requested Castro film. Henny caption footer conflicts with its Alameda opening text; Glenn explicitly identifies the first two as Alameda.

Popbar local page has eight pictured/named products but no current prices. National 103-flavor catalog is New York availability, not a Berkeley menu. Local Instagram hours conflict with official store-page hours; neither is asserted alone. Review prices and promotions are not current menu prices.

Shabu Club official linked menu leaves price spaces blank; 48 unpriced food/set/add-on entries per page display Ask for price and cannot order. Both location pages link the same Burlingame-titled August2026 menu.

Hinata supplied local profile verifies address and hours; current owner menu/prices not recovered. Former hinatasushikitchen.org unavailable; no menu or prices copied from unrelated Hinata SF or third-party aggregators. Local phone from Downtown Hayward association corroboration.

Mikiya standard menu linked on both canonical owner location pages has three tiers55/78/98 regular and48/68/88 member. Two priced variants per tier and complete set contents/terms preserved. Older four-tier images and dated October owner lunch promotion not substituted for this menu.
Home recipes by Mike and Emari use New England Lobster ingredients; not on-site reviews or restaurant menu dishes. Mike is first only in this business review list. Foodies first24 unchanged.
Popbar Hugh film is Anaheim2020; Nataly Mikiya film is Cerritos. Both play on creators/Watch with explicit other-branch attribution. Four-film per business cap preserved via creator links.
Fasho/Newbie and Clones are retained as literal submitted text without inventing extra instructions. Carla current @carlacharisse_ posts use her existing stable @carlaylayyy page.

Full priced restaurant menus: Ones90rows; Fork30rows plus paid option panel; Lobster93priced food/nonalcoholic rows. Unpriced standalone coleslaw held in information panel; market/catering/merchandise and alcohol outside restaurant menu scope. Fork site’s CashApp transfer is not exposed as online ordering.

Late pre-release refetch includes Chance’s Fork It review shared at08:40:18.240580. No follow-up message at this snapshot; included under the standing publish scope, on the existing creator page and Watch because Fork It already has four inline films.
